@graph.name: Customer Trust in Website Score
@graph.description: The Customer Trust in Website Score (CTWS) is EPG Global ONE’s proprietary tool: a score from 0 to 100 that shows how much the errors and problems found on a website may reduce a customer’s trust in the company and make it harder for them to contact the company or make a purchase. Five criteria are considered: language and grammar, meaning and accuracy, clarity for the customer, presentation, website functionality. Scoring starts at 100 points; 10 points are deducted for a critical error, 4 points for a serious error, and 2 points for a minor error; a repeated error is counted once. Scale: below 50 errors seriously undermine customer trust, 50-69 noticeable errors make it harder for customers to trust the website, 70-89 individual errors reduce the overall impression of the website, 90-100 the website is perceived well and customer trust is high.
